mrDescBrowser: 负责窗口、标签管理、应用生命周期，以及各浏览器进程之间的协调。
Handles windows, tab management, app lifecycle and coordination between browser processes.
mrDescGpu: 负责页面合成、动画、视频和硬件加速绘制；关闭硬件加速后占用通常会降低。
Handles page compositing, animation, video and hardware-accelerated drawing; usage usually drops when hardware acceleration is off.
mrDescExtBackground: 承载已安装扩展的后台页面或服务，扩展启用期间可能持续运行。
Hosts background pages or workers of installed extensions; may keep running while extensions are enabled.
mrDescRenderer: 负责这个标签页的页面内容、脚本、样式与交互。
Renders this tab's page content, scripts, styles and interactions.
mrNameSharedRenderer: 共享网页渲染进程 · {count} 个标签
mrDescSharedRenderer: 这些同站点标签页共用一个渲染进程，显示的是共享进程内存，不能精确拆分到单个页面。
These same-site tabs share one renderer process; the memory shown is for the shared process and can't be split per page.
mrDescBrowserUi: 浏览器自身的界面渲染进程，用于显示工具栏、弹窗或内部管理页面。
The browser's own UI renderer process, showing the toolbar, dialogs or internal management pages.
mrDescSubframe: 通常由跨站 iframe 或隔离页面创建，用于提升网页安全性与稳定性。
Usually created by cross-site iframes or isolated pages to improve web security and stability.
mrDescOtherProcess: 浏览器或 Chromium 运行所需的独立系统进程。
A standalone system process required by the browser or Chromium.
mrDescNetwork: 负责网页请求、连接复用、代理与网络安全隔离。
Handles web requests, connection reuse, proxying and network security isolation.
mrDescAudio: 负责网页和浏览器界面的音频播放、混音与设备访问。
Handles audio playback, mixing and device access for web pages and the browser UI.
mrDescStorage: 负责站点数据、缓存和浏览器内部存储的读写。
Reads and writes site data, cache and the browser's internal storage.
mrDescMedia: 负责视频解码、摄像头或屏幕采集等媒体任务。
Handles media tasks such as video decoding, camera or screen capture.
mrDescDecoder: 在隔离环境中解析图片、JSON 等不受信任的数据。
Parses untrusted data such as images and JSON in an isolated environment.
mrDescProxy: 负责系统代理和自动代理脚本的解析。
Resolves the system proxy and automatic proxy scripts.
mrDescUtilityGeneric: Chromium 按需启动的隔离服务，用于承载浏览器基础能力。
An on-demand isolated Chromium service hosting core browser capabilities.
